scope: Company clock runtime review of explicit host input, prepare/commit replay, view/restore, persistence boundary, legacy state defaults and imported material isolation

checks.name: invalid-host-input-preserves-display-and-input
checks.details: Infinity, extra fields, ±1e12 overflow and string input all raised invalid-presentation-input. Previous input and analog hand rotation remained unchanged.

checks.name: host-input-does-not-churn-document
checks.details: setPresentationInputs changed imported display objects while revision and serialized document stayed unchanged. save() output contained no clockSeconds field.

checks.name: prepared-layout-commits-with-latest-host-input
checks.details: A candidate prepared at 33330.5 was committed after input changed to 43215.25. The committed analog hand used 43215.25 and the presentation input remained latest.

checks.name: view-and-restore-reapply-latest-input
checks.details: Room view and restore preserved logical document/view and current presentation input. Building view hid facility meshes and returning to a floor rebuilt clocks with the current host input.

checks.name: legacy-omitted-clock-state
checks.details: Analog and digital clock documents with facility state omitted restored through derive/restore and received resource defaults.

checks.name: imported-material-isolation
checks.details: All eight looks loaded and built through the actual asset library on CPU. Two same-resource digital instances received distinct cloned materials. Mutating one segment emissiveIntensity left the other at 1.

commands: node --input-type=module < CPU runtime checks for clock-display/render
node --input-type=module < preload and build all eight clock looks with asset library
limits: No browser or GPU run was performed in this independent review. Parent reports browser coverage separately.
Geometry and material validator coverage belongs to the separate geometry/material review.
